essence: Kurukulla is accompanied by the two opposing ones and Vipracitta in the third position
One should worship the mother, Mudra, and Mitra in the fifth triangle
The smiling attendants hold up the index finger with the left hand
After careful worship one should present the offering
One should always keep the used offering in a pure place
